pattern: The generated cards still give themselves away through extra small hard edges inside the subject: ribbed suit seams, rows of drum lugs, bandage strips, droplets and seeds, and plaid grids. Those push edge density above the real range. Many also have a continuous dark contour around heads and props (high outline_darkness), and background clutter is drawn as sharply as the subject. The real cards use fewer, broader internal seams and let silhouettes go soft or disappear where they meet the background.
